text: Take þese herbys Sawg . Egrimonie . Dauke . myntes . Origanum . Piliole rial . Beteyne . Malwe of euery of þese iiij handful . ysope . saþereie Cost . Persle . Englische galingale . Rose Marine Tyme . hertes tonge of euery of þese ij hanful . ffenel spegrauel (?) cerefoyle Saxefrage . leuy of lorere (?) . Sowtheryn Wode . Madynshere of euery of þese j handful . Pollipodie rote . þe rote of enula campana . Radiche roote . Tormentille . pigle . Endyue . Violet of euery of þese iij handful . Solsecle loueage . Wyldsawge . Mugwort Wodebynde . worwod . leuys of þe wyld brere herbe Iohannum Centore of euery of þese j handful . Roote of made and of Auence viij handful . Take al þese herbis and put to a C galowns of water and let hem seþe to þe þridde partie after þis put to v galowns of water and a Galown of hony . ȝif þyn hony is good and clene þan do it ouer þe fyr and lat it seþe wel and skeme it clene and whan it is wel j soden let it kele and clense it and do it in a uessel and close it þerinne a monþe or more
